notes: Address match: the ordering page states 'Pickup at Bellwood, 504 Mannheim Road, Bellwood, IL 60104'. Data read on 2026-11-10 from the restaurant's own Popmenu ordering menu (same domain; the page data, not a screenshot). The site blocks plain HTTP fetches (403), so it was read in a real browser. Prices are the online-ordering prices shown on the restaurant's own site; they are odd amounts (e.g. $4.68, $5.20), which suggests an online-ordering uplift over in-store prices - in-store prices were not verified. The public menu page https://www.tasteerolls.com/menu-bellwood shows the same price for the one item spot-checked (Apple Pie Egg Roll $6.76). Whole numbers in the data were written with two decimals as the site displays them (5.2 -> $5.20). Full menu has 10 sections (also Other, Drinks, Roll'd & Ready Combos, Desserts) and about 110 items; this is a selection. Section name 'FOOT LONG 12 inch Egg Rolls', and item names '12 inch OBAMA', 'TWISTED FT LONG', 'TWO (2) Meat Rice Bowl', 'THREE (3) Meat Rice Bowl', 'CHEESE Fry Small (SM)' were title-cased. One listed foot-long ('12 inch Mango Habanero Chicken' at $7.00) looked out of line with the others and was left out. Descriptions are '' where the menu gives none; the menu spells giardiniera 'giardiana' on the Obama roll.
sourceDetail: Tastee Rolls website, Bellwood online ordering menu
